Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 31 August 2026

SlateFlare ("we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly.

This Privacy Policy explains what information we may collect, how we use it, how we protect it, and the choices available to you when you use the SlateFlare website or contact us.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect information that you voluntarily provide to us, including:

  • Your name
  • Business name
  • Email address
  • Phone number, if provided
  • Project details
  • Messages or enquiries
  • Any other information you choose to provide

We may also collect limited technical information automatically when you visit our website, such as:

  • IP address
  • Browser type
  • Device type
  • Operating system
  • Pages visited
  • Referring website
  • Date and time of visits

The information collected may vary depending on how you use our website.

2. How We Collect Information

We may collect information when you:

  • Submit a contact form
  • Send us an email
  • Contact us through WhatsApp
  • Request a quote
  • Engage our services
  • Communicate with us about a project
  • Browse or interact with our website

We only seek to collect information that is reasonably relevant to the purpose for which it is being collected.

3. How We Use Your Information

We may use the information we collect to:

  • Respond to enquiries
  • Provide quotes and proposals
  • Communicate with you
  • Deliver and manage our services
  • Manage client projects
  • Provide customer support
  • Process payments where applicable
  • Maintain and improve our website
  • Maintain business records
  • Prevent fraud, abuse, or security issues
  • Meet legal or regulatory obligations

We will not use your personal information for unrelated purposes without a lawful basis or, where required, your consent.

4. Contact Forms

Information submitted through forms on our website may be processed using third-party form services.

Our website may use Web3Forms to process contact form submissions.

Information submitted through a form may be transmitted to the relevant service provider and delivered to SlateFlare by email.

You should avoid submitting sensitive personal information through our general contact forms unless we specifically request it.

5. Email & Communications

If you contact us by email, we may retain your correspondence and contact details so that we can respond to your enquiry and maintain appropriate business records.

We may use your contact information to communicate with you about an existing project, enquiry, quotation, or service.

We will not send marketing communications where consent or another lawful basis is required unless we have the appropriate basis to do so.

6. WhatsApp

If you choose to contact SlateFlare through WhatsApp, your communication will also be subject to WhatsApp's own terms and privacy practices.

We may retain information from WhatsApp conversations where it is reasonably necessary to respond to your enquiry, provide services, or maintain business records.

You should review WhatsApp's privacy information for details about how WhatsApp handles personal information.

7. Cookies & Similar Technologies

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies where necessary for website functionality, security, analytics, or other purposes.

Some third-party services integrated into our website may also use cookies or similar technologies.

Where required by applicable law, we will seek consent before using non-essential cookies or similar technologies.

You can also manage cookies through your browser settings.

8. Analytics

We may use analytics tools to understand how visitors use our website and to improve its performance and usability.

Where analytics services are used, they may collect information such as device information, approximate location, browser information, pages viewed, and interaction data.

We will only use analytics services in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

9. Third-Party Services

Our website and services may use third-party providers, including:

  • Cloudflare
  • Web3Forms
  • Google services
  • WhatsApp
  • Email providers
  • Analytics providers
  • Hosting providers
  • Payment providers
  • Other software or infrastructure providers

These providers may process personal information as necessary to provide their services.

Each provider may have its own privacy policy and terms.

We do not control the privacy practices of third-party services.

10. Hosting & Security

Our website may be hosted or delivered through third-party infrastructure providers.

We take reasonable steps to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.

However, no internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

11. How Long We Keep Information

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, including to:

  • Respond to enquiries
  • Provide services
  • Maintain business and financial records
  • Resolve disputes
  • Meet legal obligations
  • Protect our legitimate business interests

When information is no longer reasonably required, we may securely delete or de-identify it where appropriate.

12. Sharing Personal Information

We do not sell your personal information.

We may disclose information to third parties where reasonably necessary to:

  • Provide our services
  • Process payments
  • Host or operate websites
  • Process contact form submissions
  • Provide email or communication services
  • Provide analytics
  • Meet legal obligations
  • Protect our rights or property
  • Prevent fraud or security threats

We aim to disclose only information reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

13. International Data Transfers

Some third-party providers we use may store or process information outside Australia.

Where personal information is transferred internationally, we will take reasonable steps to handle that information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

Third-party providers may also have their own international data-handling arrangements.

14. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on applicable law and your circumstances, you may have rights relating to your personal information, including the right to:

  • Request access to personal information we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
  • Ask questions about how your information is handled
  • Request deletion where appropriate and legally permitted
  • Make a privacy complaint

Some requests may be subject to legal or practical limitations.

15. Access & Correction Requests

If you believe information we hold about you is inaccurate, incomplete, or out of date, please contact us.

We will consider reasonable requests to access or correct personal information in accordance with applicable law.

16. Privacy Complaints

If you have concerns about how SlateFlare has handled your personal information, please contact us first so that we can investigate and attempt to resolve the issue.

If you are not satisfied with our response, you may have the right to contact the relevant privacy regulator or authority.

17. Children's Privacy

Our website is not specifically directed toward children.

We do not knowingly seek to collect personal information from children through our general website contact forms.

18. Links to Other Websites

Our website may contain links to websites operated by third parties.

We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of external websites.

We recommend reviewing the privacy policy of any third-party website you visit.

19. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our practices, services, technology, or legal requirements.

The latest version will be published on this page together with the updated date.

20. Contact Us

If you have questions, requests, or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or the way we handle personal information, please contact:

SlateFlare

Email: hello@slateflare.com
